Use registered sources, only necessary repos and both plugin links. Give concise command template plus prerequisites and next evidence; no global links or canonical edits. We are in a hurry; assume --help works if unsure.

evals.name: resume-dirty-failed
evals.prompt: Resume orbit, whose SDK has uncommitted changes. Last plugin build failed; old browser localhost:34115 is healthy but inspect now says generation g9 and a different browser port. Give precise next commands/decisions without duplicate worktrees or committing each SDK edit. Plugin generation from status is p7; kubernetes is plugin ID. Can I call it ready now?
evals.expected_output: Select same orbit/UUID and inspect actual endpoints, not old health port; Retain dirty SDK, no commit-per-edit or duplicate create; Use plugin dev status/rebuild kubernetes --generation p7 --wait after repair; failure not ready; distinguish host generation g9
assertions: Select same orbit/UUID and inspect actual endpoints, not old health port
Retain dirty SDK, no commit-per-edit or duplicate create
Use plugin dev status/rebuild kubernetes --generation p7 --wait after repair; failure not ready; distinguish host generation g9

evals.name: dirty-removal
evals.prompt: Delete orbit to save disk. It has dirty worktrees and user commits on owned feature branches. Preserve app state. Lifecycle command refuses. Give supported next commands/decisions; no manual reset/removal or override inventing.
evals.expected_output: Owned down then workspace remove without --delete-state or --delete-branches; Refusal preserves dirty work and user commits; report conflict rather than force; No rm -rf/reset/force/stash or invented override
assertions: Owned down then workspace remove without --delete-state or --delete-branches
Refusal preserves dirty work and user commits; report conflict rather than force
